verdict.rationale: Manufact documents a few built-in, event-triggered background automations. Pushing to the production branch deploys automatically, deployment paths and triggers are configurable, and users can set a publish checklist to run automatically after each successful deployment. These are narrow pipeline triggers, not a general facility for defining autonomous automations. Missing for 10: a general user-defined automation or workflow builder, recurring or scheduled runs, autonomous agent tasks beyond deploy/check pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Pushing to your production branch triggers a deployment automatically
you can start a checklist automatically after each successful deployment
